packages.name: haloce-nx
packages.title: Halo: Combat Evolved
packages.author: nx-mod
packages.description: Halo: Combat Evolved from the decompilation, drawn with deko3d, with online play through OpenCE. Needs your own Xbox disc image.
packages.details:
Halo: Combat Evolved from the decompilation, drawn with deko3d, with online play through OpenCE. Needs your own Xbox disc image.

Install
1. Make an image of your own Halo: Combat Evolved Xbox disc (.iso or .xiso).
2. Copy it to haloce-nx/ at the root of the SD card.
3. Start halo.nro with full memory. The first start copies the game data out of the image.

Your files, in haloce-nx/
- Halo: Combat Evolved Xbox disc image (required), one of:
  - Disc image (.iso): *.iso (Your Xbox disc)
  - Disc image (.xiso): *.xiso (Your Xbox disc)
- Custom Edition maps (optional): custom_maps/*.map (Sent by the host to players who lack them)

On the Switch: The first start copies the maps and movies out of the disc image, then starts the game.

Launch
- Start it with full memory: hold R while starting a game, or use a forwarder. Not from the Album.
- The game updates itself from its GitHub releases, asking first.

packages.name: sa2-nx
packages.title: Sonic Adventure 2
packages.author: ChanseyIsTheBest
packages.description: Sonic Adventure 2 (Xbox Live Arcade), statically recompiled with ReXGlue and drawn with deko3d: 60 FPS at stock clocks. Needs your own Xbox 360 copy, converted on a PC.
packages.details:
Sonic Adventure 2 (Xbox Live Arcade), statically recompiled with ReXGlue and drawn with deko3d: 60 FPS at stock clocks. Needs your own Xbox 360 copy, converted on a PC.

Install
1. On a PC, open https://chanseyisthebest.github.io/sa2-nx-installer/
2. Give it the package file 525E7BB1E72A2DB99AB79281BA24938048198FAD58, or the whole 58411202 folder from your Xbox 360 (the Battle DLC is optional), and press Create sa2-nx.zip.
3. Extract sa2-nx.zip to the root of the SD card. It makes switch/sa2-nx/.
4. Start sa2.nro with full memory.

Your files, in switch/sa2-nx/
- Game files made by the web installer from your Xbox 360 copy (required): game_root.nxpack (The game's files, about 1.2 GB), game_root.nxidx (Index of the pack), deko3d_glsl.bin (Shaders made from your copy)

On a PC, with sa2-nx web installer (https://chanseyisthebest.github.io/sa2-nx-installer/): The installer page converts your Xbox 360 package in the browser: movies to H.265, music to Opus, everything else into one pack.

Launch
- Start it with full memory: hold R while starting a game, or use a forwarder. Not from the Album.
- A forwarder must be set to a 39-bit address space.
- Hold A+B+X+Y+L+R for the game menu.

packages.name: triaevum
packages.title: Ocarina of Time 3D Recompiled
packages.author: JohnUzoka
packages.description: TriAevum, the Ocarina of Time 3D recompilation, on Switch with gyro aiming, touch controls and in-game updates. Needs your own decrypted cartridge dump.
packages.details:
TriAevum, the Ocarina of Time 3D recompilation, on Switch with gyro aiming, touch controls and in-game updates. Needs your own decrypted cartridge dump.

Install
1. Dump and decrypt your own Ocarina of Time 3D cartridge with GodMode9 on a modded 3DS. eShop copies (.cia) and other versions do not work.
2. Copy the .3ds or .cci file to switch/oot3dre/.
3. Start the game with full memory. The first start imports the dump.

Your files, in switch/oot3dre/
- Ocarina of Time 3D cartridge dump, decrypted: USA Rev 1, or European (original or Rev 1) (required), one of:
  - Cartridge dump (.3ds): *.3ds (Your decrypted dump)
  - Cartridge dump (.cci): *.cci (Your decrypted dump)
  - Extracted dump: import/code.bin (Decompressed code), import/exheader.bin (ExHeader), import/romfs.bin (RomFS (IVFC))
- Single Screen Experience HUD art, for consoles without internet (optional): singlescreen_322.zip (The game offers to download it itself when online)
- HD texture pack (HenrikoMagnifico, 1080p) (optional): textures/pack.json (Turn on in L3+R3, Video, HD textures)

On the Switch: The first start turns your dump into the game files (about a minute), then asks whether to keep the dump.

Launch
- Start it with full memory: hold R while starting a game, or use a forwarder. Not from the Album.
- A Sphaira forwarder works. Forwarders from the nsp-forwarder website have been reported to close the game.
- Press both sticks in (L3+R3) for settings, the performance overlay and updates.
